context: Request: which associates have patent-litigation experience (for staffing a new patent-infringement case). Rubric (no matter numbers in titles): associates Christy Bauer, Omar Siddiqui, Peter Vassiliev, Wendy Schultz (matters 1014-00003, 1014-00004, 1037-00004, 1013-00005) and Priya Subramaniam (lead associate on a patent-enforcement engagement referenced in the 1031-00001 conflicts file), plus a precision criterion. divergence: All three runs failed the same criterion: each named the four associates from the four patent-litigation matters and missed the fifth associate, whose role appears only in a conflicts matter's documents. T0 and T2 had that conflicts matter in their scan output (T0 a high hit count, T2 a hit count and an agenda snippet) but chose what to list and read by patent-specific file names and kept to the litigation matters (surfaced, not opened, at the listing stage). T1's content scans timed out and its retry ran only over five matters it had picked, so the conflicts matter never surfaced (search miss). Reviews in every run flagged hand-picked narrowing, generically in T0 and T2 and with the exact cause in T1, and none named the conflicts matter. Label notes were ignored once in each of T0 and T2.
